_README: Exceptions built into license-gate, used when a repository has no allowlist of its own (.github/license-allowlist.json). 'accepted' = reviewed and fine. 'acknowledged_copyleft' = strong/network copyleft that is tracked for removal: listed here it is reported but does not fail the check.

accepted.name: certifi
accepted.reason: MPL-2.0 is file-level (weak) copyleft. certifi is Mozilla's CA bundle, used unmodified as a dependency of requests/httpx; only changes to certifi's own files would carry obligations.
